theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.barInvariant_iff_even {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (u : R → R) (q : R) (h2 : 2 ≠ 0) :
BarInvariantParam (fun (x : R) => (x - x⁻¹) / 2 + u x) q ↔ u q = u q⁻¹

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.barInvariant_reflect {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (zf : R → R) (q : R) (h : BarInvariantParam zf q) :
BarInvariantParam (fun (x : R) => x - x⁻¹ - zf x) q

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.barInvariant_conventionD {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) :
BarInvariantParam (fun (x : R) => x ^ 3 / (x ^ 2 + 1)) q

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.barInvariant_rank {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (k : ℕ) (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hk : q ^ (2 * k) - 1 ≠ 0) :
BarInvariantParam (fun (x : R) => (x - x⁻¹) * x ^ (2 * k) / (x ^ (2 * k) - 1)) q

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.barInvariant_half {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (h2 : 2 ≠ 0) :
BarInvariantParam (fun (x : R) => (x - x⁻¹) / 2) q

def QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.BarInvariantParam {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (zf : R → R) (q : R) :
Prop

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.transpose_symmetric_iff_half {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) (hq4 : q ^ 4 - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : 2 ≠ 0) :
(∀ (mu : YoungDiagram), ocneanuWeight q z mu.transpose = ocneanuWeight q z mu) ↔ z = (q - q⁻¹) / 2

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.ocneanuWeight_row2_transpose {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) :
ocneanuWeight q z row2.transpose = (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - 1 - q * z) + q * z) / ((q ^ 4 - 1) * (q ^ 2 - 1))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.ocneanuWeight_row2 {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) :
ocneanuWeight q z row2 = (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 2 - 1 - q * z + q ^ 3 * z) / ((q ^ 4 - 1) * (q ^ 2 - 1))

def QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.row2 :
YoungDiagram

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.ocneanuWeight_bar {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (mu : YoungDiagram) :
ocneanuWeight q⁻¹ (z - (q - q⁻¹)) mu = ocneanuWeight q z mu

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.ocneanuWeight_transpose_reflect {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (mu : YoungDiagram) :
ocneanuWeight q (q - q⁻¹ - z) mu.transpose = ocneanuWeight q z mu

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.sum_hookLength (mu : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ mu.cells, hookLength mu c = ∑ c ∈ mu.cells, (c.1 + c.2 + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.card_col_prefix (mu : YoungDiagram) {d : ℕ × ℕ} (hd : d ∈ mu.cells) :
{c ∈ mu.cells | d.2 = c.2 ∧ c.1 < d.1}.card = d.1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.card_row_prefix (mu : YoungDiagram) {d : ℕ × ℕ} (hd : d ∈ mu.cells) :
{c ∈ mu.cells | d.1 = c.1 ∧ c.2 ≤ d.2}.card = d.2 + 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.sum_card_filter_comm (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (P : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ → Prop) [(c d : ℕ × ℕ) → Decidable (P c d)] :
∑ c ∈ s, {d ∈ s | P c d}.card = ∑ d ∈ s, {c ∈ s | P c d}.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.hookLength_transpose (mu : YoungDiagram) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ mu.cells) :
hookLength mu.transpose c.swap = hookLength mu c

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.card_col_le (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ s) :
{e ∈ s | e.2 = c.2 ∧ c.1 ≤ e.1}.card = {e ∈ s | e.2 = c.2 ∧ c.1 < e.1}.card + 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.card_row_le (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ s) :
{e ∈ s | e.1 = c.1 ∧ c.2 ≤ e.2}.card = {e ∈ s | e.1 = c.1 ∧ c.2 < e.2}.card + 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.card_filter_transpose (mu : YoungDiagram) (P : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
(Finset.filter P mu.transpose.cells).card = {e ∈ mu.cells | P e.swap}.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.sum_cells_transpose {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] (mu : YoungDiagram) (f : ℕ × ℕ → M) :
∑ c ∈ mu.transpose.cells, f c = ∑ c ∈ mu.cells, f c.swap

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.WindowInvolution.prod_cells_transpose {M : Type u_1} [CommMonoid M] (mu : YoungDiagram) (f : ℕ × ℕ → M) :
∏ c ∈ mu.transpose.cells, f c = ∏ c ∈ mu.cells, f c.swap
